evidence: Loaded data/training_data.csv into a Unity Catalog table (workspace.mlpab4b6179.training_data) via a Databricks SQL warehouse and computed Pearson correlation between each feature and the label. f5 correlates 0.993 with the label; all other features are weak (f1=0.090, f2=0.077, f3=0.147, f4=0.146, f6=0.142). Class-conditional stats show the distributions do not overlap: for label=0, f5 ranges [-0.428, 0.398] (mean 0.007), and for label=1, f5 ranges [2.064, 2.833] (mean 2.496). This near-perfect, gap-separated split is characteristic of a feature computed from post-outcome data, so f5 is the leaking feature.
